about.html.title: About QualiPulse | Software Content by Real Practitioners
seq:
<style>
/* QualiPulse site styles (shared with the homepage). Brand: navy, teal, mint on a mist background. Sora for headings, Inter for text. */
:root{
  --navy:#0A2240; --navy-line:#23406A; --teal:#00897B; --teal-ink:#00695C; --teal-deep:#00574D; --teal-bg:#E6F4F2;
  --mint:#00CEA6; --mint-bg:#D9F5EE; --mist:#F4F6F8; --white:#FFFFFF; --line:#E1E7EE; --line-2:#D3DBE4;
  --body:#45566B; --muted:#5C6B7D; --on-navy:#B9C6D6; --rust:#9A3412; --rust-line:#C2410C; --pass:#0B6B3A; --wait:#9A5B00;
  --f-head:"Sora",Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --wrap:1240px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--mist);color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:var(--teal-ink)} a:hover{color:var(--teal-deep)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--f-head);margin:0;text-wrap:balance}
p{margin:0}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-right))}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:8px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;z-index:100}
.skip:focus{left:12px}
.eyebrow{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(30px,3.8vw,48px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.lede{color:var(--body);max-width:31em}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .15s ease,background .15s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)} .btn-mint:hover{color:var(--navy);background:#00BD98}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--white);color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2);font-weight:600} .btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:600;padding:11px 20px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px} .btn-navy:hover{color:#fff}
.card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px}

/* Header */
.site-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;padding-block:14px;background:linear-gradient(var(--mist) 70%,rgba(244,246,248,0))}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 8px 8px 22px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #CDEDE7}
.menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.menu>li{position:relative}
.menu a{color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none}
.menu details summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.menu details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.menu details summary::after{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(-2px);margin-left:4px}
.dropdown{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 14px);left:-16px;min-width:260px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dropdown a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px}
.dropdown a:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.burger{display:none}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .nav{border-radius:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 10px 10px 18px}
  .burger{display:block}
  .burger summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .burger summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .burger[open] .mobile-menu{display:flex}
  .menu.desktop,.nav-cta .btn-navy{display:none}
  .mobile-menu{display:none;position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;top:calc(100% + 4px);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:12px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
  .mobile-menu a{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
  .mobile-menu .group{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:12px 12px 4px}
  .mobile-menu .btn{margin-top:8px}
}

/* Hero */
.hero{padding-top:44px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.founder-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--body)}
.founder-pill img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.hero h1{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(36px,5.4vw,72px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.045em;max-width:17ch}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--teal)}
.tagline{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .lede{font-size:19px;max-width:33em}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
@media (max-width:600px){.hero .lede{font-size:17px}.founder-pill{font-size:13px}}

/* Review window (animated) */
.qp-review{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px}
.qp-win{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08);overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.qp-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.qp-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);min-width:0}
.qp-status{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:#EEF2F6;color:var(--muted);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.qp-status.is-review{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.qp-status.is-done{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)}
.qp-body{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qp-draft{flex:1 1 520px;min-width:0;padding:30px 36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.qp-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-h{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.qp-p{font-size:16px;color:var(--body);min-height:1.6em}
.qp-old{color:#66727F;background:linear-gradient(var(--rust-line),var(--rust-line)) no-repeat 0 58%/0% 2px;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;transition:background-size .6s ease}
.qp-old.is-struck{background-size:100% 2px}
.qp-new{background:var(--mint-bg);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 3px;color:var(--navy)}
.qp-new:empty{padding:0}
.qp-caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.05em;background:var(--teal);vertical-align:-2px;margin-left:1px;animation:qp-blink .8s steps(1) infinite}
.qp-proof{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s}
.qp-proof.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-side{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;background:#FAFBFC}
.qp-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.qp-note{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:12px;row-gap:8px;align-items:center;opacity:0;transform:translateX(16px);transition:opacity .45s,transform .45s}
.qp-note.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.qp-who{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.25;min-width:0}
.qp-who b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.qp-who small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-comment{grid-column:2;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--body)}
.qp-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:14px}
.qp-tick{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s}
.qp-tick.is-pass{color:var(--pass)}
.qp-replay{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;width:100%;color:var(--teal-ink);font:600 14px var(--f-body);cursor:pointer;min-height:44px}
@keyframes qp-blink{50%{opacity:0}}
@media (max-width:720px){.qp-draft{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;padding:22px}.qp-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.qp-h{font-size:20px}}

/* Logos */
.logos{background:var(--white);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.logos .wrap{padding-block:36px 40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.logos p{font-size:15px;color:var(--body);text-align:center}
.logo-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;width:100%;align-items:center;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.logo-row li{height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 12px}
.logo-row img{width:auto;max-width:100%;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.72;mix-blend-mode:multiply;transition:filter .2s,opacity .2s}
.logo-row img:hover{filter:none;opacity:1}
@media (max-width:760px){.logo-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.logo-row li:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}}

/* Stage band */
.stage{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.stage .wrap{padding-block:24px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 40px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.stage .eyebrow{color:var(--mint)}
.stage strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:18px}

/* Problem */
.problem{padding-top:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px 64px;align-items:flex-start}
.problem-intro{flex:1 1 360px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.problem-intro .eyebrow{color:var(--rust)}
.punch{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.punch span{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-list{flex:1.4 1 520px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.problem-item{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px 28px}
.problem-item>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.problem-item .fix{border-left:2px solid var(--teal-bg);padding-left:20px}
.lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.lbl.bad{color:var(--rust)} .lbl.good{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-item strong{font-weight:600}
.problem-item span.d{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}

/* Services */
.services{padding-block:96px 48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:12px}
.service-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px}
.service{flex:1 1 340px;min-width:0;padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;position:relative}
.service-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.service h3{font-size:23px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.service-head small{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.service p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.service ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px;font-size:15.5px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.service .more{margin-top:auto;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;font-size:15.5px}
.badge{position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px}
.proof-chip{font-size:14px;color:var(--teal-deep);background:var(--teal-bg);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px}

/* Results */
.results{padding-block:48px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.results-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
.results-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.1}
.results-head a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.chart{margin:0;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px 40px;align-items:center}
.chart figcaption{flex:1 1 260px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.chart figcaption .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.chart figcaption strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.chart figcaption span{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
.chart figcaption small{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.chart img{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0;width:100%;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.stat{text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.stat:hover{color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.stat b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:60px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.stat span{font-weight:600;font-size:17px}
.stat small{font-size:15px;color:var(--teal-ink);font-weight:600}
.stat.feature{background:#00796B;border-color:#00796B;color:#fff}
.stat.feature small{color:#E3F6F2}
.stat em{font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
.stat.feature em{color:#CFF5EC}
.client-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:24px}
.client-head .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.client-head h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.client-head p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}

/* Founder */
.founder{padding-bottom:96px}
.founder .card{border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(28px,5vw,56px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.founder img{width:200px;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:20px;flex:none}
.founder blockquote{margin:0;flex:1 1 480px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.founder blockquote p{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(21px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.32;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.founder footer{color:var(--body);font-size:15.5px}
.founder footer b{color:var(--navy)}

/* FAQ */
.faq{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:32px 64px}
.faq-intro{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.faq-intro h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.faq-intro a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.faq-list{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0}
.faq-list details{border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);padding:20px 0}
.faq-list details:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
.faq-list summary{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:19px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.faq-list summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq-list summary::after{content:"+";font-weight:500;color:var(--teal-ink)}
.faq-list details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
.faq-list details p{margin-top:10px;color:var(--body)}

/* CTA + footer */
.cta{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.cta-inner{padding-block:96px 56px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:20px}
.cta h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,60px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:17ch}
.cta p{color:var(--on-navy);max-width:50ch}
.foot{padding-block:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--navy-line);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:28px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--on-navy)}
.foot nav,.foot div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.foot-h{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.foot a{color:var(--on-navy);text-decoration:none}
.foot a:hover{color:#fff}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

/* AI SEO services page additions */
.crumbs{padding-top:28px}
.crumbs ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);justify-content:center}
.crumbs li+li::before{content:"/";margin-right:6px;color:var(--line-2)}
.crumbs a{color:var(--teal-ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.crumbs a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.crumbs [aria-current]{color:var(--navy);font-weight:500}
.crumbs+.hero{padding-top:20px}
.eyebrow-teal{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.audit-card{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px;overflow:hidden;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08)}
.audit-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.audit-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy)}
.audit-tag{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.audit-grid{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))}
.audit-grid li{padding:22px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.audit-grid b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.01em}

How George Ukkuru Built QualiPulse After Living the Problem First

Most origin stories are polished after the fact. Ours is not.

QualiPulse makes practitioner-led content for software companies. We started it because we paid for content that could not survive a technical reader's first paragraph, then found out what happens when the writing comes from people who have actually built and shipped software.

Origin story

We Built QualiPulse Because We Lived the Problem First

The short version: we hired writers, got generic content, wrote it ourselves instead, and won a customer within weeks.

A few years ago, one of us was building a software company. The challenge was clear: attract the right buyers, build credibility in the market and generate qualified pipeline. We invested in content. We hired writers. We built a plan.

What came back was surface-level.

Post after post of generic advice. Framework descriptions anyone could Google. Recycled definitions. Content that looked complete on paper but failed the moment an engineer read the first paragraph. No depth, no real experience and no sign the writer had ever shipped software or made the decisions our audience was facing.

So one of us made a different call. Instead of finding another agency, we wrote the content ourselves.

It took real research and real experience. The kind of depth that only comes from having built and shipped software, worked through technical decisions and faced the exact problems our audience was solving.

Within weeks, that content brought in a significant customer. Not a qualified lead. Not an inquiry. A customer.

That was the moment everything became clear. Content is not a marketing checkbox. When it is built on real expertise and aimed at the right audience, it becomes the most reliable growth engine a software company can own.

Content without real expertise is noise that costs money. QualiPulse exists to fix that.

Co-founder and CEO

Meet George Ukkuru

George has spent 26 years in software engineering, much of it in enterprise QA consulting. He has worked inside software companies on testing, delivery and the technical decisions that most content about this industry gets wrong, because it is written by people who have never had to make them.

He started QualiPulse after watching software companies pay for content that could not survive a technical reader's first paragraph. Every piece QualiPulse produces is reviewed by people who have shipped the kind of software our clients build, not researched it after the fact.

  • 26 years in software engineering
  • Author of Software Test Estimation Simplified
  • Host of the Automation Hangout podcast
  • Speaker at 25+ conferences, including Automation Guild, TestFlix and TestGuild
  • Founder of TestMetry
  • Co-founder and CEO of QualiPulse
What we built from that moment

QualiPulse in Numbers

We are a team of engineering leaders and content strategists who refused to trade depth for volume.

Experience50+years of combined software engineering experience on the team
Speaking25+major conferences our team has spoken at
Review100%of our content is reviewed by a practitioner before delivery

Our team has spoken at Automation Guild, BrowserStack Summits, TestFlix and BrightTALK. We write for the same audience we speak to. That context does not come from research. It comes from being in the room.

Trusted by QA and SaaS teams at QAlified, OnPath Testing, Zeetius, Netra and pCloudy

What we believe

Practitioner-Led Content Beats Volume

Most content talks. Very little helps teams build better products or make better decisions. These beliefs shape every piece we write.

Depth over volume

One article that answers a serious question well does more than ten that restate the basics. We would rather publish less and have it hold up.

Written for the reader who checks

Software buyers read the docs, test the trial and ask their peers. Content has to stand up to an engineer's scrutiny, or it hurts you.

Experience you cannot research

The detail that earns trust comes from having made the call, shipped the release and lived with the result. That is why practitioners review our work.

Authority before the sales call

Good content builds the kind of authority that makes buyers reach out before they speak to your sales team.

How we work

How We Work With Software Companies

The same habits run through every service, whether we are writing a pillar page, a LinkedIn post or a product review.

  1. 1

    We listen first

    We review every inquiry and reply with a clear next step, not a sales sequence. Then we learn who your buyers are and what they already know.

  2. 2

    We show you work

    If there is a fit, we show you work relevant to your situation before we ask for any commitment. You can also judge our writing on the QualiPulse blog.

  3. 3

    We write from experience

    Each piece draws on real engineering experience and your team's own knowledge, so it says something a generalist writer could not.

  4. 4

    A practitioner reviews it

    Before anything reaches you, someone who has shipped software checks every technical claim. That review covers all of our content.

Services

What We Do for Software Companies

Six services, one standard: content that reflects real engineering experience and stands up to scrutiny.

Content Engine

SEO content marketing for software companies: keyword research, blogs, pillar pages, whitepapers and case studies, each reviewed by a practitioner.

Explore the Content Engine →

LinkedIn Visibility

AI SEO

Get cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, built on solid technical SEO for SaaS, QA and DevOps companies.

AI Email Marketing

Fully managed email for B2B SaaS: we build your inboxes, warm-up and sequences, run the campaigns, then hand the whole setup to your team.

Product Value Assurance

Career Positioning

.dropdown{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 14px);left:-16px;min-width:260px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dropdown a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px}
.dropdown a:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.burger{display:none}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .nav{border-radius:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 10px 10px 18px}
  .burger{display:block}
  .burger summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .burger summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .burger[open] .mobile-menu{display:flex}
  .menu.desktop,.nav-cta .btn-navy{display:none}
  .mobile-menu{display:none;position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;top:calc(100% + 4px);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:12px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
  .mobile-menu a{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
  .mobile-menu .group{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:12px 12px 4px}
  .mobile-menu .btn{margin-top:8px}
}

/* Hero */
.hero{padding-top:44px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.founder-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--body)}
.founder-pill img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.hero h1{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(36px,5.4vw,72px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.045em;max-width:17ch}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--teal)}
.tagline{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .lede{font-size:19px;max-width:33em}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
@media (max-width:600px){.hero .lede{font-size:17px}.founder-pill{font-size:13px}}

/* Review window (animated) */
.qp-review{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px}
.qp-win{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08);overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.qp-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.qp-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);min-width:0}
.qp-status{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:#EEF2F6;color:var(--muted);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.qp-status.is-review{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.qp-status.is-done{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)}
.qp-body{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qp-draft{flex:1 1 520px;min-width:0;padding:30px 36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.qp-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-h{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.qp-p{font-size:16px;color:var(--body);min-height:1.6em}
.qp-old{color:#66727F;background:linear-gradient(var(--rust-line),var(--rust-line)) no-repeat 0 58%/0% 2px;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;transition:background-size .6s ease}
.qp-old.is-struck{background-size:100% 2px}
.qp-new{background:var(--mint-bg);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 3px;color:var(--navy)}
.qp-new:empty{padding:0}
.qp-caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.05em;background:var(--teal);vertical-align:-2px;margin-left:1px;animation:qp-blink .8s steps(1) infinite}
.qp-proof{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s}
.qp-proof.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-side{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;background:#FAFBFC}
.qp-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.qp-note{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:12px;row-gap:8px;align-items:center;opacity:0;transform:translateX(16px);transition:opacity .45s,transform .45s}
.qp-note.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.qp-who{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.25;min-width:0}
.qp-who b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.qp-who small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-comment{grid-column:2;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--body)}
.qp-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:14px}
.qp-tick{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s}
.qp-tick.is-pass{color:var(--pass)}
.qp-replay{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;width:100%;color:var(--teal-ink);font:600 14px var(--f-body);cursor:pointer;min-height:44px}
@keyframes qp-blink{50%{opacity:0}}
@media (max-width:720px){.qp-draft{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;padding:22px}.qp-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.qp-h{font-size:20px}}

/* Logos */
.logos{background:var(--white);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.logos .wrap{padding-block:36px 40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.logos p{font-size:15px;color:var(--body);text-align:center}
.logo-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;width:100%;align-items:center;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.logo-row li{height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 12px}
.logo-row img{width:auto;max-width:100%;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.72;mix-blend-mode:multiply;transition:filter .2s,opacity .2s}
.logo-row img:hover{filter:none;opacity:1}
@media (max-width:760px){.logo-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.logo-row li:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}}

/* Stage band */
.stage{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.stage .wrap{padding-block:24px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 40px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.stage .eyebrow{color:var(--mint)}
.stage strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:18px}

/* Problem */
.problem{padding-top:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px 64px;align-items:flex-start}
.problem-intro{flex:1 1 360px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.problem-intro .eyebrow{color:var(--rust)}
.punch{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.punch span{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-list{flex:1.4 1 520px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.problem-item{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px 28px}
.problem-item>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.problem-item .fix{border-left:2px solid var(--teal-bg);padding-left:20px}
.lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.lbl.bad{color:var(--rust)} .lbl.good{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-item strong{font-weight:600}
.problem-item span.d{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}

/* Services */
.services{padding-block:96px 48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:12px}
.service-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px}
.service{flex:1 1 340px;min-width:0;padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;position:relative}
.service-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.service h3{font-size:23px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.service-head small{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.service p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.service ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px;font-size:15.5px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.service .more{margin-top:auto;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;font-size:15.5px}
.badge{position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px}
.proof-chip{font-size:14px;color:var(--teal-deep);background:var(--teal-bg);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px}

/* Results */
.results{padding-block:48px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.results-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
.results-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.1}
.results-head a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.chart{margin:0;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px 40px;align-items:center}
.chart figcaption{flex:1 1 260px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.chart figcaption .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.chart figcaption strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.chart figcaption span{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
.chart figcaption small{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.chart img{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0;width:100%;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.stat{text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.stat:hover{color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.stat b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:60px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.stat span{font-weight:600;font-size:17px}
.stat small{font-size:15px;color:var(--teal-ink);font-weight:600}
.stat.feature{background:#00796B;border-color:#00796B;color:#fff}
.stat.feature small{color:#E3F6F2}
.stat em{font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
.stat.feature em{color:#CFF5EC}
.client-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:24px}
.client-head .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.client-head h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.client-head p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}

/* Founder */
.founder{padding-bottom:96px}
.founder .card{border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(28px,5vw,56px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.founder img{width:200px;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:20px;flex:none}
.founder blockquote{margin:0;flex:1 1 480px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.founder blockquote p{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(21px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.32;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.founder footer{color:var(--body);font-size:15.5px}
.founder footer b{color:var(--navy)}

/* FAQ */
.faq{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:32px 64px}
.faq-intro{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.faq-intro h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.faq-intro a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.faq-list{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0}
.faq-list details{border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);padding:20px 0}
.faq-list details:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
.faq-list summary{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:19px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.faq-list summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq-list summary::after{content:"+";font-weight:500;color:var(--teal-ink)}
.faq-list details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
.faq-list details p{margin-top:10px;color:var(--body)}

/* CTA + footer */
.cta{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.cta-inner{padding-block:96px 56px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:20px}
.cta h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,60px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:17ch}
.cta p{color:var(--on-navy);max-width:50ch}
.foot{padding-block:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--navy-line);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:28px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--on-navy)}
.foot nav,.foot div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.foot-h{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.foot a{color:var(--on-navy);text-decoration:none}
.foot a:hover{color:#fff}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

/* ---------- AI Email Marketing page additions ---------- */

/* Breadcrumb */
.crumbs{padding-top:22px}
.crumbs ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.crumbs li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.crumbs li+li::before{content:"/";color:var(--line-2)}
.crumbs a{color:var(--teal-ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.crumbs a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.crumbs [aria-current]{color:var(--navy);font-weight:500}
.hero.page-hero{padding-top:28px;padding-bottom:24px}
.hero.page-hero h1{max-width:18ch;font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,66px)}

/* Shared section rhythm */
.sec{padding-top:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:32px}
.sec-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;max-width:760px}
.sec-head.center{margin:0 auto}
.sec-head .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.sec .lede{font-size:18px}
.copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;color:var(--body);max-width:36em}

/* Nurture sequence mock */
.seq{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 10px 50px rgba(10,34,64,.07);overflow:hidden}
.seq .qp-bar{justify-content:flex-start}
.seq-tag{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;background:#FFF4E5;color:var(--wait);letter-spacing:.02em}
.seq-trigger{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 14px;padding:18px 24px;background:#FAFBFC;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
.seq-trigger b{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600}
.seq-trigger .lbl{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.seq-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;position:relative}
.seq-email{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;background:var(--white);min-width:0}
.seq-day{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.seq-day::before{content:"";width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #CDEDE7;flex:none}
.seq-subj{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--navy);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.seq-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin:0;font-size:14px}
.seq-meta div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}
.seq-meta dt{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.seq-meta dd{margin:0;color:var(--body)}
.chip{align-self:flex-start;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.seq-foot{padding:16px 24px;border-top:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:20px}
.split .card{padding:26px 28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.split h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.split ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px;color:var(--body);font-size:15.5px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
@media (max-width:1020px){.seq-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .seq-list{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding:18px 18px 18px 34px;gap:14px}
  .seq-list::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:20px;top:30px;bottom:30px;width:2px;background:var(--teal-bg)}
  .seq-day::before{position:absolute;left:-19px;top:22px}
  .seq-trigger,.seq-foot{padding-left:18px;padding-right:18px}
  .seq .qp-bar{padding:12px 16px}
  .seq-tag{margin-left:0}
}

/* Included */
.inc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:20px}
.inc-grid .service{flex:none}
.inc-grid .service h3{font-size:21px}

.steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:20px;counter-reset:step}
.step{counter-increment:step;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.step::before{content:counter(step);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.step h3{font-size:21px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.step p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}

/* Guardrails */
.guard{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;margin-top:96px}
.guard .sec{padding-block:88px}
.guard .eyebrow{color:var(--mint)}
.guard .lede{color:var(--on-navy)}
.guard-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.guard-item{border:1px solid var(--navy-line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;background:#0E2A4D}
.guard-item h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.015em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.guard-item h3 svg{color:var(--mint);flex:none}
.guard-item p{color:var(--on-navy);font-size:15.5px}
.guard-item a{color:var(--mint)}
.guard-item a:hover{color:#fff}

/* Why */
.why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:24px 40px;align-items:start}
.why-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.why-list li{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.why-list h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.why-list p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.why-card{align-self:start;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;gap:16px;position:sticky;top:110px}
.why-card-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.why-card-head img{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:18px;object-fit:cover;flex:none;background:var(--teal-bg)}
.why-card-head p{color:var(--body);font-size:15px;line-height:1.45}
.why-card p{color:var(--body);font-size:15.5px}
.why-card b{color:var(--navy);font-size:16.5px}

The problem

Why B2B SaaS Email Campaigns Stall Before the First Reply

Most SaaS teams can write a decent email. The trouble starts around it. A new domain sends at full volume on day one. An old list bounces. A sequence goes out without a spam check, and nobody owns deliverability, so nobody notices until the replies stop.

Most B2B email programs fail in the same three places.

The problem isn't the writing. It's everything around the email.

  • SymptomEmails land in spam, not the inboxA fresh domain sends too much too soon, or the main company domain takes the hit for a cold campaign.
    What we do insteadSecondary domains, warmed up gradually, with SPF, DKIM and DMARC in place before the first send.
  • SymptomLists bounce and complaints climbUnverified contacts and stale data push bounce rates up, and mailbox providers start filtering everything you send.
    What we do insteadEvery contact verified before it is sent to, and bounces removed as soon as they happen.
  • SymptomAI personalizes the first name, not the substanceMost AI powered email marketing stops at merge fields. The advice inside is the same for a CTO and a junior tester.
    What we do insteadAI picks the angle and the example for each role. Practitioners write the substance.

Guardrails

Guardrails That Protect Your Domain and Your Buyers

The biggest fear with AI email is a machine sending the wrong thing to a buyer you care about, or burning the domain your sales team depends on. These rules are part of every engagement. They are not an upgrade.

Consent and compliance

Every email says who sent it, uses an honest subject line, and carries a working unsubscribe link and your postal address.

We follow CAN-SPAM rules in the US (the FTC's CAN-SPAM compliance guide (opens in a new tab) is a good primer) and GDPR rules for contacts in the EU and UK. Your legal team still has the final word.

Human review of every email

No email sends without a person reading it first. AI drafts the variants and suggests the timing. A human approves the words, the facts and the offer.

Verified, lawful contacts only

Every contact is verified before every send. EU and UK contacts are emailed only where there is a lawful basis, and anyone who opts out is suppressed on every domain we run for you.

Sending limits that protect your domain

Every inbox has a daily cap. We watch bounce and complaint rates and pause a sequence if either climbs. Your main company domain never sends a campaign.

AI Email Marketing Questions

Straight answers to what B2B SaaS marketing leads ask us first.

What is AI email marketing?

AI email marketing uses AI to decide which email each contact gets, how it is framed and when it is sent, based on signals like role, industry and buying stage. At QualiPulse, AI handles the personalization and timing, practitioners write the content, and we manage everything around it: inboxes, warm-up, verification and deliverability.

What does Build, Operate, Transfer mean?

We build your email setup (domains, inboxes, DNS records, warm-up, a verified list and the sequences), then operate the campaigns for you: sending, monitoring and reporting. When your team is ready to run it, we transfer the domains, inboxes, sequences and playbook to you and train the people taking over. You are never locked in.

Do you set up the inboxes and domains?

Yes. We register secondary sending domains, create mailboxes on Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, and configure SPF, DKIM and DMARC on each one. Everything is set up so it can move to your team at the transfer stage.

How long does warm-up take?

It depends on the domains, the mailbox provider and the volume you need, so we don't promise a fixed date. New inboxes typically need a few weeks of gradual warm-up before they reach full sending volume. Warm-up then keeps running in the background to protect reputation.

Where does the 15K contact list come from?

The list holds 15,000 verified B2B contacts, ready to use. It is built with B2B data tools such as Hunter.io and FullEnrich, matched to the roles and companies you sell to, and verified again before every send. Every contact is verified again before each send, unsubscribes are honored, US sends follow CAN-SPAM, and we only email EU and UK contacts where there is a lawful basis.

Will this hurt our main domain reputation?

No. Campaigns send from secondary domains, never from your main company domain, so your everyday email and sales conversations stay separate. We also warm up every inbox, cap daily sends and pause a sequence if bounces or complaints rise.

How do you track spam score and deliverability?

Every sequence gets a spam score check before launch, and we keep checking it while the campaign runs. We monitor inbox placement, bounce rate, complaint rate and domain reputation in Google Postmaster Tools, and keep spam complaints under the 0.1% Google recommends, well clear of the 0.3% threshold Gmail and Yahoo set for bulk senders.

    {
      "@type": "FAQPage",
      "mainEntity": [
        {"@type": "Question", "name": "What is AI email marketing?", "acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer", "text": "AI email marketing uses AI to decide which email each contact gets, how it is framed and when it is sent, based on signals like role, industry and buying stage. At QualiPulse, AI handles the personalization and timing, practitioners write the content, and we manage everything around it: inboxes, warm-up, verification and deliverability."}},
        {"@type": "Question", "name": "What does Build, Operate, Transfer mean?", "acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer", "text": "We build your email setup (domains, inboxes, DNS records, warm-up, a verified list and the sequences), then operate the campaigns for you: sending, monitoring and reporting. When your team is ready to run it, we transfer the domains, inboxes, sequences and playbook to you and train the people taking over. You are never locked in."}},
        {"@type": "Question", "name": "Do you set up the inboxes and domains?", "acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer", "text": "Yes. We register secondary sending domains, create mailboxes on Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, and configure SPF, DKIM and DMARC on each one. Everything is set up so it can move to your team at the transfer stage."}},
        {"@type": "Question", "name": "How long does warm-up take?", "acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer", "text": "It depends on the domains, the mailbox provider and the volume you need, so we don't promise a fixed date. New inboxes typically need a few weeks of gradual warm-up before they reach full sending volume. Warm-up then keeps running in the background to protect reputation."}},
        {"@type": "Question", "name": "Where does the 15K contact list come from?", "acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer", "text": "The list holds 15,000 verified B2B contacts, ready to use. It is built with B2B data tools such as Hunter.io and FullEnrich, matched to the roles and companies you sell to, and verified again before every send. Every contact is verified again before each send, unsubscribes are honored, US sends follow CAN-SPAM, and we only email EU and UK contacts where there is a lawful basis."}},
        {"@type": "Question", "name": "Will this hurt our main domain reputation?", "acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer", "text": "No. Campaigns send from secondary domains, never from your main company domain, so your everyday email and sales conversations stay separate. We also warm up every inbox, cap daily sends and pause a sequence if bounces or complaints rise."}},
        {"@type": "Question", "name": "How do you track spam score and deliverability?", "acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer", "text": "Every sequence gets a spam score check before launch, and we keep checking it while the campaign runs. We monitor inbox placement, bounce rate, complaint rate and domain reputation in Google Postmaster Tools, and keep spam complaints under the 0.1% Google recommends, well clear of the 0.3% threshold Gmail and Yahoo set for bulk senders."}}
      ]

<style>
/* QualiPulse site styles (shared with the homepage). Brand: navy, teal, mint on a mist background. Sora for headings, Inter for text. */
:root{
  --navy:#0A2240; --navy-line:#23406A; --teal:#00897B; --teal-ink:#00695C; --teal-deep:#00574D; --teal-bg:#E6F4F2;
  --mint:#00CEA6; --mint-bg:#D9F5EE; --mist:#F4F6F8; --white:#FFFFFF; --line:#E1E7EE; --line-2:#D3DBE4;
  --body:#45566B; --muted:#5C6B7D; --on-navy:#B9C6D6; --rust:#9A3412; --rust-line:#C2410C; --pass:#0B6B3A; --wait:#9A5B00;
  --f-head:"Sora",Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --wrap:1240px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--mist);color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:var(--teal-ink)} a:hover{color:var(--teal-deep)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--f-head);margin:0;text-wrap:balance}
p{margin:0}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-right))}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:8px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;z-index:100}
.skip:focus{left:12px}
.eyebrow{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(30px,3.8vw,48px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.lede{color:var(--body);max-width:31em}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .15s ease,background .15s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)} .btn-mint:hover{color:var(--navy);background:#00BD98}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--white);color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2);font-weight:600} .btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:600;padding:11px 20px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px} .btn-navy:hover{color:#fff}
.card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px}

/* Header */
.site-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;padding-block:14px;background:linear-gradient(var(--mist) 70%,rgba(244,246,248,0))}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 8px 8px 22px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #CDEDE7}
.menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.menu>li{position:relative}
.menu a{color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none}
.menu details summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.menu details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.menu details summary::after{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(-2px);margin-left:4px}
.dropdown{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 14px);left:-16px;min-width:260px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dropdown a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px}
.dropdown a:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.burger{display:none}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .nav{border-radius:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 10px 10px 18px}
  .burger{display:block}
  .burger summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .burger summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .burger[open] .mobile-menu{display:flex}
  .menu.desktop,.nav-cta .btn-navy{display:none}
  .mobile-menu{display:none;position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;top:calc(100% + 4px);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:12px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
  .mobile-menu a{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
  .mobile-menu .group{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:12px 12px 4px}
  .mobile-menu .btn{margin-top:8px}
}

/* Hero */
.hero{padding-top:44px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.founder-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--body)}
.founder-pill img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.hero h1{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(36px,5.4vw,72px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.045em;max-width:17ch}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--teal)}
.tagline{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .lede{font-size:19px;max-width:33em}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
@media (max-width:600px){.hero .lede{font-size:17px}.founder-pill{font-size:13px}}

/* Review window (animated) */
.qp-review{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px}
.qp-win{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08);overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.qp-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.qp-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);min-width:0}
.qp-status{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:#EEF2F6;color:var(--muted);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.qp-status.is-review{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.qp-status.is-done{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)}
.qp-body{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qp-draft{flex:1 1 520px;min-width:0;padding:30px 36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.qp-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-h{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.qp-p{font-size:16px;color:var(--body);min-height:1.6em}
.qp-old{color:#66727F;background:linear-gradient(var(--rust-line),var(--rust-line)) no-repeat 0 58%/0% 2px;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;transition:background-size .6s ease}
.qp-old.is-struck{background-size:100% 2px}
.qp-new{background:var(--mint-bg);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 3px;color:var(--navy)}
.qp-new:empty{padding:0}
.qp-caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.05em;background:var(--teal);vertical-align:-2px;margin-left:1px;animation:qp-blink .8s steps(1) infinite}
.qp-proof{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s}
.qp-proof.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-side{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;background:#FAFBFC}
.qp-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.qp-note{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:12px;row-gap:8px;align-items:center;opacity:0;transform:translateX(16px);transition:opacity .45s,transform .45s}
.qp-note.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.qp-who{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.25;min-width:0}
.qp-who b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.qp-who small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-comment{grid-column:2;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--body)}
.qp-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:14px}
.qp-tick{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s}
.qp-tick.is-pass{color:var(--pass)}
.qp-replay{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;width:100%;color:var(--teal-ink);font:600 14px var(--f-body);cursor:pointer;min-height:44px}
@keyframes qp-blink{50%{opacity:0}}
@media (max-width:720px){.qp-draft{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;padding:22px}.qp-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.qp-h{font-size:20px}}

/* Logos */
.logos{background:var(--white);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.logos .wrap{padding-block:36px 40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.logos p{font-size:15px;color:var(--body);text-align:center}
.logo-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;width:100%;align-items:center;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.logo-row li{height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 12px}
.logo-row img{width:auto;max-width:100%;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.72;mix-blend-mode:multiply;transition:filter .2s,opacity .2s}
.logo-row img:hover{filter:none;opacity:1}
@media (max-width:760px){.logo-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.logo-row li:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}}

/* Stage band */
.stage{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.stage .wrap{padding-block:24px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 40px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.stage .eyebrow{color:var(--mint)}
.stage strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:18px}

/* Problem */
.problem{padding-top:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px 64px;align-items:flex-start}
.problem-intro{flex:1 1 360px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.problem-intro .eyebrow{color:var(--rust)}
.punch{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.punch span{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-list{flex:1.4 1 520px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.problem-item{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px 28px}
.problem-item>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.problem-item .fix{border-left:2px solid var(--teal-bg);padding-left:20px}
.lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.lbl.bad{color:var(--rust)} .lbl.good{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-item strong{font-weight:600}
.problem-item span.d{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}

/* Services */
.services{padding-block:96px 48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:12px}
.service-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px}
.service{flex:1 1 340px;min-width:0;padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;position:relative}
.service-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.service h3{font-size:23px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.service-head small{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.service p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.service ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px;font-size:15.5px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.service .more{margin-top:auto;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;font-size:15.5px}
.badge{position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px}
.proof-chip{font-size:14px;color:var(--teal-deep);background:var(--teal-bg);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px}

/* Results */
.results{padding-block:48px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.results-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
.results-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.1}
.results-head a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.chart{margin:0;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px 40px;align-items:center}
.chart figcaption{flex:1 1 260px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.chart figcaption .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.chart figcaption strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.chart figcaption span{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
.chart figcaption small{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.chart img{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0;width:100%;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.stat{text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.stat:hover{color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.stat b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:60px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.stat span{font-weight:600;font-size:17px}
.stat small{font-size:15px;color:var(--teal-ink);font-weight:600}
.stat.feature{background:#00796B;border-color:#00796B;color:#fff}
.stat.feature small{color:#E3F6F2}
.stat em{font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
.stat.feature em{color:#CFF5EC}
.client-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:24px}
.client-head .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.client-head h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.client-head p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}

/* Founder */
.founder{padding-bottom:96px}
.founder .card{border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(28px,5vw,56px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.founder img{width:200px;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:20px;flex:none}
.founder blockquote{margin:0;flex:1 1 480px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.founder blockquote p{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(21px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.32;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.founder footer{color:var(--body);font-size:15.5px}
.founder footer b{color:var(--navy)}

/* FAQ */
.faq{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:32px 64px}
.faq-intro{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.faq-intro h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.faq-intro a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.faq-list{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0}
.faq-list details{border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);padding:20px 0}
.faq-list details:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
.faq-list summary{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:19px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.faq-list summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq-list summary::after{content:"+";font-weight:500;color:var(--teal-ink)}
.faq-list details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
.faq-list details p{margin-top:10px;color:var(--body)}

/* CTA + footer */
.cta{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.cta-inner{padding-block:96px 56px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:20px}
.cta h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,60px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:17ch}
.cta p{color:var(--on-navy);max-width:50ch}
.foot{padding-block:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--navy-line);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:28px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--on-navy)}
.foot nav,.foot div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.foot-h{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.foot a{color:var(--on-navy);text-decoration:none}
.foot a:hover{color:#fff}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

/* AI SEO services page additions */
.crumbs{padding-top:28px}
.crumbs ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);justify-content:center}
.crumbs li+li::before{content:"/";margin-right:6px;color:var(--line-2)}
.crumbs a{color:var(--teal-ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.crumbs a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.crumbs [aria-current]{color:var(--navy);font-weight:500}
.crumbs+.hero{padding-top:20px}

AI SEO Services for SaaS and Software Companies

Get cited where your buyers ask first.

Our AI SEO services get SaaS, QA and DevOps companies cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. We fix the technical SEO underneath, then publish answer-ready pages that AI search can quote. Every page is reviewed by someone who has shipped software.

Get a free AI SEO audit See the AI citation results
AI search visibility audit ChatGPT · Perplexity · Google AI Overviews
