.site-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;padding-block:14px;background:linear-gradient(var(--mist) 70%,rgba(244,246,248,0))}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 8px 8px 22px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #CDEDE7}
.menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.menu>li{position:relative}
.menu a{color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none}
.menu details summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.menu details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.menu details summary::after{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(-2px);margin-left:4px}
.dropdown{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 14px);left:-16px;min-width:260px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dropdown a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px}
.dropdown a:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.burger{display:none}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .nav{border-radius:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 10px 10px 18px}
  .burger{display:block}
  .burger summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .burger summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .burger[open] .mobile-menu{display:flex}
  .menu.desktop,.nav-cta .btn-navy{display:none}
  .mobile-menu{display:none;position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;top:calc(100% + 4px);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:12px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
  .mobile-menu a{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
  .mobile-menu .group{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:12px 12px 4px}
  .mobile-menu .btn{margin-top:8px}
}

/* Hero */
.hero{padding-top:44px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.founder-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--body)}
.founder-pill img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.hero h1{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(36px,5.4vw,72px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.045em;max-width:17ch}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--teal)}
.tagline{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .lede{font-size:19px;max-width:33em}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
@media (max-width:600px){.hero .lede{font-size:17px}.founder-pill{font-size:13px}}

/* Review window (animated) */
.qp-review{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px}
.qp-win{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08);overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.qp-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.qp-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);min-width:0}
.qp-status{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:#EEF2F6;color:var(--muted);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.qp-status.is-review{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.qp-status.is-done{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)}
.qp-body{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qp-draft{flex:1 1 520px;min-width:0;padding:30px 36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.qp-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-h{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.qp-p{font-size:16px;color:var(--body);min-height:1.6em}
.qp-old{color:#66727F;background:linear-gradient(var(--rust-line),var(--rust-line)) no-repeat 0 58%/0% 2px;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;transition:background-size .6s ease}
.qp-old.is-struck{background-size:100% 2px}
.qp-new{background:var(--mint-bg);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 3px;color:var(--navy)}
.qp-new:empty{padding:0}
.qp-caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.05em;background:var(--teal);vertical-align:-2px;margin-left:1px;animation:qp-blink .8s steps(1) infinite}
.qp-proof{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s}
.qp-proof.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-side{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;background:#FAFBFC}
.qp-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.qp-note{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:12px;row-gap:8px;align-items:center;opacity:0;transform:translateX(16px);transition:opacity .45s,transform .45s}
.qp-note.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.qp-who{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.25;min-width:0}
.qp-who b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.qp-who small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-comment{grid-column:2;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--body)}
.qp-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:14px}
.qp-tick{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s}
.qp-tick.is-pass{color:var(--pass)}
.qp-replay{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;width:100%;color:var(--teal-ink);font:600 14px var(--f-body);cursor:pointer;min-height:44px}
@keyframes qp-blink{50%{opacity:0}}
@media (max-width:720px){.qp-draft{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;padding:22px}.qp-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.qp-h{font-size:20px}}

/* Logos */
.logos{background:var(--white);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.logos .wrap{padding-block:36px 40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.logos p{font-size:15px;color:var(--body);text-align:center}
.logo-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;width:100%;align-items:center;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.logo-row li{height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 12px}
.logo-row img{width:auto;max-width:100%;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.72;mix-blend-mode:multiply;transition:filter .2s,opacity .2s}
.logo-row img:hover{filter:none;opacity:1}
@media (max-width:760px){.logo-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.logo-row li:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}}

/* Stage band */
.stage{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.stage .wrap{padding-block:24px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 40px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.stage .eyebrow{color:var(--mint)}
.stage strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:18px}

/* Problem */
.problem{padding-top:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px 64px;align-items:flex-start}
.problem-intro{flex:1 1 360px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.problem-intro .eyebrow{color:var(--rust)}
.punch{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.punch span{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-list{flex:1.4 1 520px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.problem-item{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px 28px}
.problem-item>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.problem-item .fix{border-left:2px solid var(--teal-bg);padding-left:20px}
.lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.lbl.bad{color:var(--rust)} .lbl.good{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-item strong{font-weight:600}
.problem-item span.d{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}

/* Services */
.services{padding-block:96px 48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:12px}
.service-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px}
.service{flex:1 1 340px;min-width:0;padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;position:relative}
.service-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.service h3{font-size:23px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.service-head small{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.service p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.service ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px;font-size:15.5px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.service .more{margin-top:auto;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;font-size:15.5px}
.badge{position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px}
.proof-chip{font-size:14px;color:var(--teal-deep);background:var(--teal-bg);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px}

/* Results */
.results{padding-block:48px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.results-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
.results-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.1}
.results-head a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.chart{margin:0;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px 40px;align-items:center}
.chart figcaption{flex:1 1 260px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.chart figcaption .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.chart figcaption strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.chart figcaption span{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
.chart figcaption small{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.chart img{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0;width:100%;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.stat{text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.stat:hover{color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.stat b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:60px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.stat span{font-weight:600;font-size:17px}
.stat small{font-size:15px;color:var(--teal-ink);font-weight:600}
.stat.feature{background:#00796B;border-color:#00796B;color:#fff}
.stat.feature small{color:#E3F6F2}
.stat em{font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
.stat.feature em{color:#CFF5EC}
.client-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:24px}
.client-head .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.client-head h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.client-head p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}

/* Founder */
.founder{padding-bottom:96px}
.founder .card{border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(28px,5vw,56px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.founder img{width:200px;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:20px;flex:none}
.founder blockquote{margin:0;flex:1 1 480px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.founder blockquote p{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(21px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.32;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.founder footer{color:var(--body);font-size:15.5px}
.founder footer b{color:var(--navy)}

/* FAQ */
.faq{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:32px 64px}
.faq-intro{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.faq-intro h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.faq-intro a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.faq-list{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0}
.faq-list details{border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);padding:20px 0}
.faq-list details:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
.faq-list summary{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:19px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.faq-list summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq-list summary::after{content:"+";font-weight:500;color:var(--teal-ink)}
.faq-list details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
.faq-list details p{margin-top:10px;color:var(--body)}

/* CTA + footer */
.cta{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.cta-inner{padding-block:96px 56px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:20px}
.cta h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,60px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:17ch}
.cta p{color:var(--on-navy);max-width:50ch}
.foot{padding-block:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--navy-line);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:28px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--on-navy)}
.foot nav,.foot div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.foot-h{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.foot a{color:var(--on-navy);text-decoration:none}
.foot a:hover{color:#fff}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

/* AI SEO services page additions */
.crumbs{padding-top:28px}
.crumbs ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);justify-content:center}
.crumbs li+li::before{content:"/";margin-right:6px;color:var(--line-2)}
.crumbs a{color:var(--teal-ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.crumbs a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.crumbs [aria-current]{color:var(--navy);font-weight:500}
.crumbs+.hero{padding-top:20px}
.eyebrow-teal{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.audit-card{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px;overflow:hidden;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08)}
.audit-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.audit-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy)}
.audit-tag{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.audit-grid{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))}
.audit-grid li{padding:22px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.audit-grid b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.audit-grid span{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
@media (max-width:720px){.audit-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.audit-tag{margin-left:0}}
.note-line{color:var(--body);font-size:16px;max-width:38em;flex-basis:100%}
.head-stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.head-stack .lede{font-size:17px}
.services .service-grid .service{flex:1 1 320px}
.service p+p{margin-top:-6px}
.service a{font-weight:600}
.how{padding-block:48px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:20px}
.step{padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.step-n{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.step h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.step p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.compare{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:28px}
.compare-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.compare-head .lede{max-width:38em}
.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;min-width:0;max-width:100%;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.cmp{width:100%;min-width:640px;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:16px}
.cmp th,.cmp td{padding:16px 22px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.cmp tbody tr:last-child th,.cmp tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.cmp thead th{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;background:#FAFBFC}
.cmp thead th:last-child{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.cmp tbody th{font-weight:600;width:22%}
.cmp td{color:var(--body)}
.cmp td:last-child{color:var(--navy);background:#F5FBFA}
.why{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.why-card{padding:30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.why-card h3{font-size:21px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.why-card p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.center-note{margin:0 auto;text-align:center}
.faq-more{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.faq-more a{font-weight:600}
.faq-list details a{font-weight:600}
.cta .cta-inner{padding-block:96px}
.btn-ghost-dark{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy-line);font-weight:600} .btn-ghost-dark:hover{color:#fff;border-color:var(--on-navy)}
.site-foot .foot{border-top:1px solid var(--navy-line)}
#included{padding-top:48px}
@media (max-width:600px){
  .cmp{min-width:0}
  .cmp thead{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
  .cmp tr,.cmp th,.cmp td{display:block;width:auto}
  .cmp tbody tr{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .cmp tbody tr:last-child{border-bottom:0}
  .cmp tbody th{width:auto;padding:16px 18px 6px;border:0;font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:17px}
  .cmp td{padding:6px 18px;border:0;font-size:15.5px}
  .cmp td:last-child{padding-bottom:16px;background:none}
  .cmp td::before{content:attr(data-label);display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
  .cmp td:last-child::before{color:var(--teal-ink)}
}
.stats.one{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,640px)}
.brand-logo{height:36px;width:auto;display:block}

/* Content Engine page additions */
.hero h1.h1-long{font-size:clamp(34px,4.8vw,62px);max-width:21ch}
.case-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:20px}
.case-link{text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy)}
.case-link:hover{color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.case-link .eyebrow{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}

B2B software case studies

These B2B software case studies show how QualiPulse ran technical content, product marketing, SEO and LinkedIn programs for software companies, with the results we could measure and the ones we could not.

The engagements below cover software and QA companies, most of them selling B2B: two IT services firms, an independent software testing company, a sports technology platform and a SaaS product company. Every card gives its headline number with the baseline, where one was recorded, and the source behind it. Some results are output counts, such as pages rebuilt, rather than business outcomes like leads or revenue. Each card also names one thing that did not work.

  • LinkedIn Ghostwriting Confidential IT services company, USA (CEO profile)
    70% more LinkedIn impressions in 25 days
    Baseline
    No starting impression count is published. The figure is the lift over 25 days of organic posting.
    Source
    The profile’s own LinkedIn analytics. Organic activity only, no ads or automation.
    Starting problem
    The CEO's profile described a job title, the last post was months old, and buyers who looked the CEO up found nothing worth following.
    What we did
    We rebuilt the headline, About section and experience around buyer outcomes, then ghostwrote five posts a week across text, carousels, infographics and video.
    What did not work
    The result measures reach only. Meetings and pipeline from the posts are not reported, so it shows visibility, not revenue.
    Read the LinkedIn case study →
  • Product Value Assurance Confidential AI-powered sports technology platform, global
    10 leads in the first 30 days after the priority fixes
    Baseline
    No lead count from before the fixes is published, so the 10 leads show the first month of results, not a measured lift.
    Source
    Leads counted in the 30 days after the priority fixes and channel changes.
    Starting problem
    Real proof from federation partnerships sat in separate channels and rarely reached buyers: one testimonial appeared across 38 LinkedIn posts.
    What we did
    We audited LinkedIn, Instagram, the website and AI search visibility, fixed the priority technical issues, and set up one proof system to feed every channel.
    What did not work
    The engagement was scoped to marketing and demand channels only, so usability and product reliability were not reviewed, and the in-product sharing feature was specced, with full rollout planned for month 4 onward.
    Read the product marketing case study →
  • Content Engine Confidential independent software testing company, USA
    20% more qualified leads from organic content over 12 months
    Baseline
    “Almost no qualified inbound” before the program. No exact starting count is published.
    Source
    Qualified leads from organic content across the 12-month retainer.
    Starting problem
    Articles written by generalists, on topics picked by instinct and published whenever someone had time, brought in almost no qualified inbound.
    What we did
    We ran a 12-month roadmap of practitioner-reviewed articles and AI testing whitepapers, each mapped to a researched keyword and a stage of the buyer journey.
    What did not work
    Nothing was published for the first three months while the buyer research, keyword map and point of view were set up.
    Read the software testing case study →
  • Technical SEO Confidential mid-sized IT services company, India
    60 pages fully reworked in five months (an output count)
    Baseline
    60 pages with technical issues, thin internal links and no schema
    Source
    The month-one technical audit that listed the pages, and the month-five handover document
    Starting problem
    The site had no GA4 or Search Console, no structured data and a thin, unmanaged backlink profile, so it barely showed up in search.
    What we did
    Over five months we ran five streams side by side: analytics setup, page fixes and schema, backlinks, local SEO, and AEO and GEO work on nine articles.
    What did not work
    Beyond 7 target keywords reaching Google page one by month three, traffic and lead results are not published, so the business impact is not shown.
    Read the technical SEO case study →
  • Content Engine Confidential SaaS product company, USA
    +35% website visitors in 90 days, with page-one keywords up from 3 to 23
    Baseline
    About 800 visitors a month, 3 keywords on Google page one and 2 qualified leads a month before the program.
    Source
    Measured over the first 90 to 100 days of the program.
    Starting problem
    The product was respected by its users, but the content meant to build awareness and inbound pipeline lacked the credibility to reach buyers before competitors did.
    What we did
    We ran a monthly program of keyword-led articles, a five-page whitepaper and LinkedIn posts, all planned ahead and reviewed by a practitioner.
    What did not work
    Lead growth is still small in absolute terms: qualified leads rose 20%, from 2 a month to about 2.4. Rankings moved faster than pipeline.
    Read the SaaS content case study →

If one of these problems sounds like yours, let’s talk it through.

.lede{color:var(--body);max-width:31em}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .15s ease,background .15s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)} .btn-mint:hover{color:var(--navy);background:#00BD98}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--white);color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2);font-weight:600} .btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-weight:600;padding:11px 20px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px} .btn-navy:hover{color:#fff}
.card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px}

/* Header */
.site-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;padding-block:14px;background:linear-gradient(var(--mist) 70%,rgba(244,246,248,0))}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 8px 8px 22px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #CDEDE7}
.menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.menu>li{position:relative}
.menu a{color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none}
.menu details summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.menu details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.menu details summary::after{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(-2px);margin-left:4px}
.dropdown{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 14px);left:-16px;min-width:260px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dropdown a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px}
.dropdown a:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.burger{display:none}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .nav{border-radius:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 10px 10px 18px}
  .burger{display:block}
  .burger summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .burger summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .burger[open] .mobile-menu{display:flex}
  .menu.desktop,.nav-cta .btn-navy{display:none}
  .mobile-menu{display:none;position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;top:calc(100% + 4px);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,34,64,.12);padding:12px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
  .mobile-menu a{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
  .mobile-menu .group{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:12px 12px 4px}
  .mobile-menu .btn{margin-top:8px}
}

/* Hero */
.hero{padding-top:44px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.founder-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--body)}
.founder-pill img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.hero h1{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(36px,5.4vw,72px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.045em;max-width:17ch}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--teal)}
.tagline{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .lede{font-size:19px;max-width:33em}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
@media (max-width:600px){.hero .lede{font-size:17px}.founder-pill{font-size:13px}}

/* Review window (animated) */
.qp-review{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px}
.qp-win{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08);overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.qp-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.qp-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);min-width:0}
.qp-status{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:#EEF2F6;color:var(--muted);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.qp-status.is-review{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.qp-status.is-done{background:var(--mint);color:var(--navy)}
.qp-body{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}
.qp-draft{flex:1 1 520px;min-width:0;padding:30px 36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.qp-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-h{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.qp-p{font-size:16px;color:var(--body);min-height:1.6em}
.qp-old{color:#66727F;background:linear-gradient(var(--rust-line),var(--rust-line)) no-repeat 0 58%/0% 2px;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;transition:background-size .6s ease}
.qp-old.is-struck{background-size:100% 2px}
.qp-new{background:var(--mint-bg);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 3px;color:var(--navy)}
.qp-new:empty{padding:0}
.qp-caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.05em;background:var(--teal);vertical-align:-2px;margin-left:1px;animation:qp-blink .8s steps(1) infinite}
.qp-proof{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s}
.qp-proof.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-side{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;background:#FAFBFC}
.qp-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.qp-note{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:12px;row-gap:8px;align-items:center;opacity:0;transform:translateX(16px);transition:opacity .45s,transform .45s}
.qp-note.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.qp-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.qp-who{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.25;min-width:0}
.qp-who b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.qp-who small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.qp-comment{grid-column:2;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--body)}
.qp-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:14px}
.qp-tick{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s}
.qp-tick.is-pass{color:var(--pass)}
.qp-replay{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;width:100%;color:var(--teal-ink);font:600 14px var(--f-body);cursor:pointer;min-height:44px}
@keyframes qp-blink{50%{opacity:0}}
@media (max-width:720px){.qp-draft{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;padding:22px}.qp-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.qp-h{font-size:20px}}

/* Logos */
.logos{background:var(--white);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.logos .wrap{padding-block:36px 40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.logos p{font-size:15px;color:var(--body);text-align:center}
.logo-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;width:100%;align-items:center;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.logo-row li{height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 12px}
.logo-row img{width:auto;max-width:100%;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.72;mix-blend-mode:multiply;transition:filter .2s,opacity .2s}
.logo-row img:hover{filter:none;opacity:1}
@media (max-width:760px){.logo-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.logo-row li:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}}

/* Stage band */
.stage{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.stage .wrap{padding-block:24px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 40px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.stage .eyebrow{color:var(--mint)}
.stage strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:18px}

/* Problem */
.problem{padding-top:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px 64px;align-items:flex-start}
.problem-intro{flex:1 1 360px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.problem-intro .eyebrow{color:var(--rust)}
.punch{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.punch span{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-list{flex:1.4 1 520px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.problem-item{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px 28px}
.problem-item>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.problem-item .fix{border-left:2px solid var(--teal-bg);padding-left:20px}
.lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.lbl.bad{color:var(--rust)} .lbl.good{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.problem-item strong{font-weight:600}
.problem-item span.d{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}

/* Services */
.services{padding-block:96px 48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:12px}
.service-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px}
.service{flex:1 1 340px;min-width:0;padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;position:relative}
.service-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.service h3{font-size:23px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.service-head small{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.service p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.service ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px;font-size:15.5px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.service .more{margin-top:auto;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;font-size:15.5px}
.badge{position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px}
.proof-chip{font-size:14px;color:var(--teal-deep);background:var(--teal-bg);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px}

/* Results */
.results{padding-block:48px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.results-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
.results-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.1}
.results-head a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.chart{margin:0;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px 40px;align-items:center}
.chart figcaption{flex:1 1 260px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.chart figcaption .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.chart figcaption strong{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.chart figcaption span{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
.chart figcaption small{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.chart img{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0;width:100%;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.stat{text-decoration:none;color:var(--navy);padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.stat:hover{color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.stat b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:60px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.stat span{font-weight:600;font-size:17px}
.stat small{font-size:15px;color:var(--teal-ink);font-weight:600}
.stat.feature{background:#00796B;border-color:#00796B;color:#fff}
.stat.feature small{color:#E3F6F2}
.stat em{font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
.stat.feature em{color:#CFF5EC}
.client-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:24px}
.client-head .eyebrow{color:var(--teal-ink);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.client-head h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.client-head p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}

/* Founder */
.founder{padding-bottom:96px}
.founder .card{border-radius:28px;padding:clamp(28px,5vw,56px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.founder img{width:200px;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:20px;flex:none}
.founder blockquote{margin:0;flex:1 1 480px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.founder blockquote p{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(21px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.32;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.founder footer{color:var(--body);font-size:15.5px}
.founder footer b{color:var(--navy)}

/* FAQ */
.faq{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:32px 64px}
.faq-intro{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.faq-intro h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.faq-intro a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.faq-list{flex:2 1 560px;min-width:0}
.faq-list details{border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);padding:20px 0}
.faq-list details:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
.faq-list summary{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:19px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.faq-list summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq-list summary::after{content:"+";font-weight:500;color:var(--teal-ink)}
.faq-list details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
.faq-list details p{margin-top:10px;color:var(--body)}

/* CTA + footer */
.cta{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.cta-inner{padding-block:96px 56px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:20px}
.cta h2{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,60px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:17ch}
.cta p{color:var(--on-navy);max-width:50ch}
.foot{padding-block:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--navy-line);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:28px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--on-navy)}
.foot nav,.foot div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.foot-h{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.foot a{color:var(--on-navy);text-decoration:none}
.foot a:hover{color:#fff}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

/* AI SEO services page additions */
.crumbs{padding-top:28px}
.crumbs ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);justify-content:center}
.crumbs li+li::before{content:"/";margin-right:6px;color:var(--line-2)}
.crumbs a{color:var(--teal-ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.crumbs a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.crumbs [aria-current]{color:var(--navy);font-weight:500}
.crumbs+.hero{padding-top:20px}
.eyebrow-teal{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.audit-card{width:100%;max-width:1040px;margin-top:20px;overflow:hidden;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 10px 60px rgba(10,34,64,.08)}
.audit-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.audit-title{margin-left:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy)}
.audit-tag{margin-left:auto;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.audit-grid{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))}
.audit-grid li{padding:22px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;border-right:1px solid #EEF2F6;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F6}
.audit-grid b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:600;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.audit-grid span{font-size:15px;color:var(--body)}
@media (max-width:720px){.audit-title{margin-left:0;flex-basis:100%;order:5}.audit-tag{margin-left:0}}
.note-line{color:var(--body);font-size:16px;max-width:38em;flex-basis:100%}
.head-stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.head-stack .lede{font-size:17px}
.services .service-grid .service{flex:1 1 320px}
.service p+p{margin-top:-6px}
.service a{font-weight:600}
.how{padding-block:48px 96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:20px}
.step{padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.step-n{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:var(--mint);font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:700;font-size:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.step h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.step p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.compare{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:28px}
.compare-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.compare-head .lede{max-width:38em}
.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;min-width:0;max-width:100%;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.cmp{width:100%;min-width:640px;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:16px}
.cmp th,.cmp td{padding:16px 22px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.cmp tbody tr:last-child th,.cmp tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.cmp thead th{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;background:#FAFBFC}
.cmp thead th:last-child{background:var(--teal-bg);color:var(--teal-deep)}
.cmp tbody th{font-weight:600;width:22%}
.cmp td{color:var(--body)}
.cmp td:last-child{color:var(--navy);background:#F5FBFA}
.why{padding-bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:36px}
.why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.why-card{padding:30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.why-card h3{font-size:21px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.why-card p{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.center-note{margin:0 auto;text-align:center}
.faq-more{color:var(--body);font-size:16px}
.faq-more a{font-weight:600}
.faq-list details a{font-weight:600}
.cta .cta-inner{padding-block:96px}
.btn-ghost-dark{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy-line);font-weight:600} .btn-ghost-dark:hover{color:#fff;border-color:var(--on-navy)}
.site-foot .foot{border-top:1px solid var(--navy-line)}
#included{padding-top:48px}
@media (max-width:600px){
  .cmp{min-width:0}
  .cmp thead{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
  .cmp tr,.cmp th,.cmp td{display:block;width:auto}
  .cmp tbody tr{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .cmp tbody tr:last-child{border-bottom:0}
  .cmp tbody th{width:auto;padding:16px 18px 6px;border:0;font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:17px}

/* QualiPulse site styles (shared with the homepage). Brand: navy, teal, mint on a mist background. Sora for headings, Inter for text. */

Written by people who have shipped software.

If you sell to engineers, product leaders or founders, generic content does not move them. Depth does. Specific detail does. The problem

The Gap That Is Killing Your Search Traffic

On one side: content writers who can write, but cannot explain technical architecture, product strategy or scaling decisions.

On the other: engineers, product leaders and founders who know exactly what matters, but cannot produce structured, SEO-driven content at scale.

This gap is where most software companies lose. We close it.

  • SymptomYour blog reads like everyone else'sThe posts restate basics your buyers learned years ago. Nobody links to them, and nobody shares them.
    What we do insteadArticles with the depth a practitioner expects, so they earn backlinks on merit.
  • SymptomYour experts never have time to writeThe best ideas sit in Slack threads and sales calls. The blog goes quiet for months.
    What we do insteadA short interview with your team, then we write, structure and publish on a steady schedule.
  • SymptomTraffic arrives, but pipeline does notPosts chase broad keywords that bring readers who will never buy.
    What we do insteadTopics picked from real buyer journeys, from first question to vendor shortlist.
Why it works

What Makes SEO Content Marketing Work for Software Companies

Software buyers are hard to impress. They read docs, test trials and ask peers. SEO content marketing works for them when three things are true.

It answers a real search

Every piece targets a question your buyers already type into Google or an AI tool. If nobody searches for it, it belongs on LinkedIn or in a sales deck, not on your blog.

It shows first-hand knowledge

Google's guidance on helpful content rewards experience you can only get by doing the work. A technical reader spots a rewritten listicle in two lines. A worked example, a real trade-off or a mistake you made keeps them reading.

It connects to a buying step

A post about a problem should lead to a post about solutions, then to a case study, then to a conversation. Content that stands alone gets traffic. Content in a chain gets pipeline.

Proof, not promises

SEO Content Marketing Results From Our Programs

Deliverables

What Our SEO Content Writing Services Include

One team handles the plan, the writing and the review. You get content your engineers would sign off on, and search engines can understand.

Keyword research and a 90-day content plan

We map search intent against real buyer journeys. We know how engineers search for technical solutions, how product leaders search for strategy guidance and how founders search for scaling advice. The output is a topic cluster plan with a clear publishing order.

SEO blog articles and pillar pages

Every article covers its topic with the depth a practitioner expects. No fluff, no restated basics. Our blog writing services cover single articles and full clusters. Pillar pages anchor each cluster, and supporting articles link back to them so authority builds in one place.

Whitepapers, ebooks and case studies

Our whitepaper writing services turn your team's expertise into gated assets that sales can use. Our case study writing services turn client wins into stories with real numbers, approved by the client before they go live.

Practitioner review on every piece

Someone who has worked in software engineering checks every technical claim before delivery. That review is what separates a SaaS content writer who sounds right from one who is right.

Structure ready for AI search

AI summaries and answer boxes reward content that is clear, well structured and answers the question directly. We write for classic rankings and AI search at the same time. For deeper work on citations, see our AI SEO services.

Visuals and distribution formats

Each blog includes two custom infographics and a featured image, with no separate design budget. Every piece also comes in an email-ready version, a newsletter summary and reusable content blocks. One deliverable, several channels.

Formats

Content Formats and When to Use Each

Different buying stages need different formats. Here is how we decide what to write, and why.

SEO blog article

Use it when a buyer has a specific question, such as how to cut flaky tests or how to price an API. Our SEO blog writing services keep each article to one question, answered fully.

Best for: early research and long-tail searches

Pillar page

Use it when a topic is broad enough to hold ten or more related articles. The pillar covers the whole subject at a high level and links out to each detailed post, so authority collects in one place.

Best for: owning a category term

Whitepaper or ebook

Use it when the buyer is comparing approaches and needs depth they can share with a team. A good whitepaper gives sales something to send after a first call.

Best for: mid-funnel evaluation and lead capture

Customer case study

Use it when the buyer needs proof that you have solved this before. Our case study writing services follow a simple shape: the problem, what changed and the measured result.

Best for: late-stage decisions and sales follow-up

Who it is for

B2B Content Writing Services for Three Kinds of Teams

Our SEO content writing services fit teams that sell to technical buyers and need every claim to hold up.

Software service companies

You need content that brings inbound from qualified buyers. That holds whether you sell testing services, DevOps consulting or platform engineering.

Software product companies

You need thought leadership that builds category authority. When every vendor in your space makes the same claims, depth and real expertise set you apart. This is where SaaS content marketing earns its keep.

Engineering and product teams

You need content that builds credibility with technical buyers and decision makers. Content that shows your team understands the real problems your customers face.

Topics we cover

We Write With Authority About

These are the subjects our writers and reviewers know from the inside, not from a quick search.

Topic research

How We Pick Topics From Search Data

A SaaS content strategy is only as good as its topic list. We build ours from data, then check it against what your sales team hears.

  1. 1

    Pull the demand

    We collect search volume and keyword difficulty for the terms around your product, plus the questions buyers ask in AI tools and forums.

  2. 2

    Read the results page

    For each term we look at what already ranks. If page one is full of thin posts, that is an opening. If it is all big brands, we look for a narrower angle.

  3. 3

    Score for fit

    Low difficulty is good, but only if the searcher could become a customer. We rank topics by buying intent first and volume second.

  4. 4

    Group into clusters

    Related topics become one cluster with one pillar page. The order you publish in comes from this map, not from whoever had an idea that week.

How it works

How We Build Your Content Program

Five steps. The first three happen before a single article is written, which is why the articles land.

  1. 1

    Understand

    We learn your business, your audience and where your content stands today.

  2. 2

    Audit

    We study what your best-ranking competitors publish and find the gaps they leave open.

  3. 3

    Plan

    We build a content roadmap tied to your buying journey, so each piece has a job.

  4. 4

    Produce and review

    We write each piece, then check it for accuracy and authenticity before delivery.

  5. 5

    Track and refine

    We watch what moves in search and adjust the program as the data comes in.

Inside one piece

Our SEO Content Writer Process, Step by Step

The program runs in five steps. Each individual piece goes through its own seven stages before it reaches you.

  1. Brief. The target keyword, the search intent, the reader, the pages that rank today and the internal links the piece must carry.
  2. Expert input. A short interview or a voice note from your team. This is where the details nobody else has come from.
  3. Outline. Headings mapped to the questions searchers ask, shared with you before drafting if you want to see it.
  4. Draft. A technical content writer drafts the piece in plain English, with the answer near the top and the detail below.
  5. Practitioner review. Someone who has worked in software engineering checks every claim, example and code reference.
  6. SEO pass. Title, meta description, headings, internal links, image alt text and schema where it fits.
  7. Delivery. The final piece, its two infographics, the featured image and the email-ready version, ready to publish.
Editorial standards

The Practitioner Review Checklist

Nothing ships until it passes these checks. It is the same list whether the piece is a short blog post or a 20-page whitepaper.

  • Every technical claim is correct, and would survive a senior engineer reading it
  • Numbers have a source, and client numbers have the client's approval
  • The main question is answered in the first few lines
  • At least one example, trade-off or lesson comes from real experience
  • No filler intros, no restated basics, no padding to hit a word count
  • Headings match what people search, not what sounds clever
  • Links point to the right pillar page and the next buying step
  • The piece reads well aloud, in plain English, with short paragraphs
Reporting

How We Measure SEO Content Marketing Results

Traffic alone can fool you. We report on four layers, from first signal to revenue, so you can see where the program is working and where it is not.

Visibility

Impressions and average position in Google Search Console, plus mentions in AI search.

Rankings

Where each target keyword sits, and which ones reached page one.

Engagement

Clicks, time on page and the internal links readers follow next.

Pipeline

Sign-ups, demo requests and leads that touched the content before they converted.

What is SEO content marketing?

SEO content marketing is the practice of planning and publishing content that ranks for the searches your buyers make, then guides them toward a purchase. It joins keyword research, writing and promotion into one program, so each article earns traffic and moves a reader closer to a conversation with you.

What are SEO content writing services?

SEO content writing services plan, write and publish content that ranks for the searches your buyers make. For software companies, that means keyword research, blog articles and pillar pages built around topic clusters, written with enough technical depth that readers trust it and other sites link to it.

What does an SEO content writer do?

An SEO content writer turns a keyword and a brief into a page that answers the searcher's question better than what already ranks. On our team, a writer drafts each piece from your expert's input, and a practitioner with software engineering experience reviews every technical claim before delivery.

What does SaaS content marketing include?

SaaS content marketing covers the content that moves a buyer from first search to shortlist: SEO blog articles, pillar pages, whitepapers, ebooks and customer case studies. Our Content Engine starts with keyword research and a 90-day content plan, then produces and reviews each piece.

Do you write whitepapers and case studies?

Yes. Our whitepaper writing services turn your team's expertise into assets sales can use, and our case study writing services turn client wins into stories with real numbers. Every case study is approved by the client before it goes live.

Do you offer blog writing services on their own?

Yes. If you already have a content plan, our SEO blog writing services can pick up from your keyword list. We still write a brief for each article and run the same practitioner review, because that is what makes the articles worth ranking.

How do you measure results?

We report on four layers: visibility in Google Search Console, rankings for your target keywords, engagement on the page and the leads or sign-ups that touched the content. You see what moved each month and what we plan to change next.

How long until the content ranks?

There is no fixed date, and anyone who promises one is guessing. It depends on your site's authority and how crowded your topics are. As one example, our technical SEO client had 7 target keywords on Google page one by month three.

Can I see a sample before I commit?

Yes. Ask for a real sample before you decide. There is no credit card and no commitment required. For plan options, see our pricing page.

FAQ · 14 questions

Technical writing agency vs freelancer: questions answered

Choosing a technical writing agency, a freelance engineer or an in-house writer comes down to accuracy, cost and how much of your team’s time each one needs. These 14 questions compare the options side by side and give you a scorecard and tests to run before you decide.

On this page: 14 questions
  1. Agency, freelancer or in-house team
  2. How do technical content agencies compare with freelance developer writers?
  3. What does a specialized technical content agency typically cost per month?
  4. Should our B2B software company hire an agency or build an internal content team?
  5. How to compare technical writing agencies
  6. Which technical content agencies understand DevTools and enterprise software buyers?
  7. How can I compare technical content agencies beyond blog volume and publishing frequency?
  8. Why does our generalist agency produce technically inaccurate software content?
  9. Is a technical content agency worth hiring if our engineers refuse to write?
  10. What should a technical content agency include in a monthly retainer?
  11. Technical content agency versus internal product marketing hire for a small SaaS team
  12. Cost, switching and tradeoffs
  13. How much cheaper are offshore technical content agencies than US-based firms?
  14. Which content partner can turn engineering expertise into enterprise pipeline?
  15. How do I evaluate whether technical writers really understand our product architecture?
  16. Our agency drives traffic but no demos. Should we switch to technical specialists?
  17. What are the tradeoffs between hiring freelance engineers and a technical content agency?

Agency, freelancer or in-house team

How do technical content agencies compare with freelance developer writers?

Freelance developer writers are useful for focused assignments requiring strong technical knowledge. Agencies can provide planning, editing, SEO, and publishing support alongside writing. Compare both using the same assignment and measure technical accuracy, delivery time, and internal review effort. The best choice depends on your existing marketing capabilities.

What does a specialized technical content agency typically cost per month?

Fees depend on the number of deliverables, research requirements, technical reviews, and supporting marketing services. Request a detailed monthly work plan rather than accepting a fixed article count. Compare the cost of producing useful, technically correct content. Publishing volume alone tells you little about whether the investment will generate business.

Should our B2B software company hire an agency or build an internal content team?

Build internally when content requires constant access to product teams and your publishing needs justify permanent roles. Hire an agency when you need several skills but cannot support a full team. Consider a combined arrangement: an internal marketing owner manages priorities while external specialists handle research, writing, and distribution.

How to compare technical writing agencies

Which technical content agencies understand DevTools and enterprise software buyers?

Look for agencies with relevant published work, including Draft.dev, Infrasity, and other specialist providers. Review how they explain security, integrations, deployment, and purchasing concerns. Enterprise buyers need different information from individual developers. Ask agencies to produce separate outlines for an engineer evaluating a tool and a manager approving its purchase.

How can I compare technical content agencies beyond blog volume and publishing frequency?

Use a scorecard covering technical accuracy, research quality, buyer understanding, revision effort, and business impact. Give shortlisted agencies the same assignment and compare the results. Ask who actually writes the content. An agency publishing fewer accurate articles may create more value than one producing large quantities of generic material.

Why does our generalist agency produce technically inaccurate software content?

Generalist writers may understand marketing but lack experience with software behavior, architecture, and engineering workflows. They can misunderstand technical terms or repeat unsupported claims. The solution is not simply better editing. Introduce technical research, working examples, and expert reviews before publication. Some topics may require specialist writers entirely. This is the gap QualiPulse was built around: writers with QA and software-delivery backgrounds, so the technical checking happens before the first draft, not after a client finds the errors.

Is a technical content agency worth hiring if our engineers refuse to write?

Yes, provided the agency can extract knowledge through interviews, documentation, demonstrations, and existing technical material. Engineers should still verify important claims. Ask the agency to describe its knowledge collection process. If it requires developers to prepare detailed drafts, it may simply transfer the writing problem back to your team. QualiPulse runs short expert interviews and drafts the piece itself, so your engineers verify facts without writing from scratch.

What should a technical content agency include in a monthly retainer?

Expect topic research, content planning, technical writing, editing, SEO support, publishing coordination, and reporting. Clarify revision limits, technical review responsibilities, and ownership of completed work. Ask whether unused deliverables carry forward. A good retainer defines outcomes and responsibilities, not just the number of articles delivered monthly.

Technical content agency versus internal product marketing hire for a small SaaS team

An internal product marketer can own positioning, customer research, launch messaging, and sales support. A technical content agency can provide writing and distribution capacity. These roles are not interchangeable. If your product's value is unclear, hiring more writers may amplify weak messaging. Resolve positioning before increasing content production.

Cost, switching and tradeoffs

How much cheaper are offshore technical content agencies than US-based firms?

Offshore agencies may charge less because of differences in operating costs, but savings depend on quality and coordination. Compare complete project costs, including technical corrections, meetings, and management time. A lower hourly rate does not guarantee a lower final cost. Request equivalent sample work before making decisions based on geography. QualiPulse is India-based, so our rates are cheaper than many US firms, but we do not compete on price. We compete on technical depth. Compare the complete project cost and the sample, not the location.

Which content partner can turn engineering expertise into enterprise pipeline?

Choose a partner who understands both software engineering and enterprise buying decisions. Ask how they would turn a technical feature into a case study, comparison guide, and sales resource. Evaluate whether the content addresses reliability, cost, security, and adoption concerns. Technical accuracy matters, but commercial relevance determines whether content influences purchases. QualiPulse brings QA and software-delivery depth plus B2B content experience, so ask us to turn one of your features into all three assets and judge the result.

How do I evaluate whether technical writers really understand our product architecture?

Ask writers to explain a real product workflow, identify dependencies, and describe what happens when a component fails. Provide an architecture diagram with limited context and encourage questions. Someone with genuine understanding will recognize missing information rather than invent details. Their questions can reveal as much as their final explanation.

Our agency drives traffic but no demos. Should we switch to technical specialists?

Not immediately. First determine whether the problem is audience selection, content topics, product messaging, or conversion paths. Review the visitors and enquiries generated by your strongest articles. If technical inaccuracies or shallow explanations prevent buyers from trusting the content, specialist writers may help. Otherwise, changing agencies may repeat the problem. Before switching to any technical specialist, including QualiPulse, run a short messaging and content audit so you know which of those four problems you actually have.

What are the tradeoffs between hiring freelance engineers and a technical content agency?

Freelance engineers bring firsthand technical knowledge but may need support with writing, SEO, and deadlines. Agencies offer broader services but may require technical supervision. Test both with the same assignment. Compare accuracy, readability, management effort, and cost. The right choice depends on which skills your company already has internally.

FAQ · 15 questions

Developer marketing agency: questions to ask before you hire

A developer marketing agency has to earn trust from readers who test claims for a living. These 15 questions cover what such an agency should do, how it differs from a DevRel agency or a content provider, what it costs in engineering review hours, and how to judge technical accuracy before you commit.

On this page: 15 questions
  1. What a developer marketing agency does
  2. What does a developer marketing agency actually do for a B2B software company?
  3. Should our DevTools startup hire a DevRel agency or technical content provider?
  4. What should I look for in a vendor creating content for software engineers?
  5. Which agencies specialize in marketing cloud infrastructure products to DevOps teams?
  6. How much does outsourced developer marketing typically cost per month?
  7. Developer content marketing that earns trust and pipeline
  8. Can a technical content agency generate qualified pipeline instead of just developer traffic?
  9. Our blog gets traffic but no demos from engineering leaders. What should we change?
  10. How do I evaluate technical writers who understand APIs, CI/CD, and test automation?
  11. What is the difference between developer marketing, DevRel, and technical content marketing?
  12. Should a small DevTools company hire freelance developer writers or a specialized agency?
  13. Which vendor can turn engineering expertise into blogs, case studies, and LinkedIn content?
  14. How can technical marketing content earn trust with skeptical software engineers?
  15. Working with engineers and choosing a vendor
  16. Our engineers refuse to write marketing content: what outsourced options work best?
  17. How do developer marketing vendors measure pipeline influence and content quality?
  18. What questions should we ask before hiring an agency for developer-focused content?

What a developer marketing agency does

What does a developer marketing agency actually do for a B2B software company?

A developer marketing agency helps engineers discover, understand, and trust software products. Its work may include tutorials, documentation, technical comparisons, community content, and product demonstrations. Unlike traditional marketing, success often begins with someone trying the product rather than booking a sales call. The content must support that journey.

Should our DevTools startup hire a DevRel agency or technical content provider?

Choose a DevRel agency when your priority is building relationships, supporting communities, and encouraging product adoption. Choose a technical content provider when you need tutorials, documentation, comparisons, and search visibility. Early startups often need useful product content before community activity. Otherwise, developers arrive interested but cannot evaluate the product independently. QualiPulse is a technical content provider, not a DevRel team, so it fits the second case and can support a community program later.

What should I look for in a vendor creating content for software engineers?

Look for curiosity, technical accuracy, and a willingness to test claims. Ask whether writers can install your product, follow documentation, and reproduce examples. A vendor who only interviews engineers may miss practical problems. Someone who actually tries the software can explain where users struggle and what makes the product useful. QualiPulse's writers come from QA and test automation, so reproducing an example and questioning a claim is part of the normal workflow, not an extra.

Which agencies specialize in marketing cloud infrastructure products to DevOps teams?

Start by evaluating agencies with published cloud infrastructure and developer tooling work, such as Draft.dev and Infrasity. Review whether they explain deployment, monitoring, security, and operating costs accurately. DevOps audiences expect practical guidance. Ask candidates to explain how their content would help an engineer avoid a deployment mistake.

How much does outsourced developer marketing typically cost per month?

Costs vary depending on whether you need articles, tutorials, community management, or complete campaign support. Request separate estimates for technical research, writing, editing, and distribution. The hidden expense is often engineering review time. Ask vendors how many hours your developers must contribute each month before comparing their proposals.

Developer content marketing that earns trust and pipeline

Can a technical content agency generate qualified pipeline instead of just developer traffic?

Yes, when content connects technical problems with purchasing decisions. Tutorials attract users, while comparisons, migration guides, security explanations, and cost analyses can attract buyers. Track whether readers belong to target companies and progress toward evaluation. A thousand developer visits may be less valuable than ten serious enterprise enquiries. QualiPulse plans content around the questions buyers ask before they purchase, which is how an agency earns its pipeline credit rather than its traffic report.

Our blog gets traffic but no demos from engineering leaders. What should we change?

Check whether your articles answer problems engineering leaders actually own, such as reliability, delivery delays, security, and operating costs. Tutorials may attract individual developers without influencing budgets. Add decision guides, architecture tradeoffs, and measurable business outcomes. Then create clear paths from those articles to product evaluations or consultations.

How do I evaluate technical writers who understand APIs, CI/CD, and test automation?

Ask writers to review a failing API test and explain its possible causes without inventing facts. Then ask them to turn the explanation into a short article. Evaluate whether they distinguish symptoms from causes, understand the tools involved, and communicate clearly. Writing quality alone cannot establish technical understanding.

What is the difference between developer marketing, DevRel, and technical content marketing?

Developer marketing focuses on attracting and converting developers into product users. DevRel builds relationships, supports adoption, and carries developer feedback into the company. Technical content marketing creates educational material that supports discovery and evaluation. These activities overlap, but their success measures differ. Treating them as identical often produces unclear responsibilities.

Should a small DevTools company hire freelance developer writers or a specialized agency?

Start with freelance writers when your founder can define topics, review drafts, and manage publishing. Consider an agency when coordination becomes a bottleneck or you need SEO, positioning, and distribution. Before choosing, calculate the founder's monthly review hours. The cheapest writing arrangement may consume the most valuable internal time.

Which vendor can turn engineering expertise into blogs, case studies, and LinkedIn content?

Look for a vendor comfortable interviewing engineers, reviewing technical documents, and adapting one idea for different audiences. A useful test is providing a recorded engineering discussion and requesting a blog outline, case study angle, and LinkedIn post. Evaluate whether all three preserve technical accuracy while serving different reader needs. QualiPulse offers LinkedIn ghostwriting alongside technical articles, so one engineering conversation can produce all three formats under the same review process.

How can technical marketing content earn trust with skeptical software engineers?

Show how the product behaves, not merely what the marketing team claims. Include working examples, known limitations, configuration details, and situations where another approach may be better. Engineers recognize exaggerated promises quickly. Explaining when your product is unsuitable can build more credibility than presenting it as the answer to everything.

Working with engineers and choosing a vendor

Our engineers refuse to write marketing content: what outsourced options work best?

Stop asking engineers to become writers. Record a short technical discussion, collect existing documentation, and let an experienced writer prepare the draft. Engineers should review accuracy rather than sentence structure. A focused twenty minute interview can be more productive than expecting a developer to write a complete article after work.

How do developer marketing vendors measure pipeline influence and content quality?

Use two sets of measures. For quality, check technical accuracy, usefulness, reader engagement, and whether engineers recommend the content. For business impact, track qualified enquiries, product trials, demo requests, and sales use. A technically excellent tutorial may deserve investment even when its immediate conversion rate is low.

What questions should we ask before hiring an agency for developer-focused content?

Ask whether the agency tests product examples, understands your target developers, and can explain technical limitations. Find out who reviews code and how mistakes are corrected. Request a sample that teaches something useful without selling aggressively. Developers respond better to practical evidence than repeated product claims disguised as education.

Need developer content your engineers would sign off on?
